name: ab-test-playbook
description: A/B testing and CRO engine: suggests test scenarios by journey stage from a 221-scenario pattern archive, designs single-variable experiments for your page, audits test proposals and renders each scenario as a side-by-side HTML card. It proposes, designs, audits and visualizes; it does not analyze results.

interface.shortDescription: Single-variable A/B test proposals, plan audits and side-by-side test cards
